I will report this to Brad. We may need to consider asking the partners to move existing meetings if possible, but that's a step to take after confirming the lack of availability. I will ask Brad to double-check his side as well. My next step will be to post a message to the workspace. I'll make it clear that I've checked all the times he's provided and none of them work.
